purpose: Compose and persist manual SQL against a bundled curated schema reference, optionally request a propose-only Helix SQL draft, and copy SQL into an external database client. The browser does not execute SQL.
primaryGoal: Understand the available schema, author or review a query, and copy the exact query for external read-only execution without losing the manual editor or implying live results.

dataSources.name: Bundled schema reference
dataSources.behavior: Deep-frozen static metadata; copied before alphabetical table sorting. Five tables and 33 documented columns, not database row counts. Column order is preserved.
dataSources.trust: Frontend and backend table/column names match the inspected curated lists; description text differs. No live database schema or physical-column existence was verified.

dataSources.name: Manual SQL draft
dataSources.behavior: Exact SQL persists in localStorage at ai.sqlPlayground.draft. Empty string removes the key; unavailable storage is silently tolerated. Run only displays external-client guidance.

dataSources.name: Optional natural-language draft
dataSources.behavior: Body is {prompt: trimmedPrompt}; bare /ai/power/sql/draft is prefixed by the canonical stream hook, not doubly prefixed. Only successful draft_readonly_sql tool results with valid typed fields become applicable drafts. Unmount aborts the request; application requires an explicit click and never executes SQL.
dataSources.trust: Inspected handler limits/validates prompt and binds install-wide table scope. AI guard is attached at route registration. Backend tools, provider behavior, redaction, authentication and actual responses were not exercised.

dataSources.name: AI feature enablement and display preferences
dataSources.endpoint: Not traced further in this bounded audit
dataSources.behavior: Fail-closed AI gate returns no optional panel when settings are absent, off or feature-disabled. Static catalog counts are passed as raw count metrics; invalid source counts are not coerced to zero by the rendered brief.

duplicatedPatterns.rule: MDC-002 / mission 33: preserve a single authoritative data contract
duplicatedPatterns.detail: Client metadata intentionally mirrors the Go curated catalog at handler.go:366-429. Names/types currently agree in the inspected lists, but separate maintenance risks drift; this is not evidence of current identifier mismatch.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep current static/offline behavior. Request an integration-owned parity check for table names, column order, SQL types and SI meaning rather than introducing a new fetch or changing the allowlist during presentation modernization.

duplicatedPatterns.rule: MDC-002: prefer existing primitives over new wrappers
duplicatedPatterns.detail: Manual and example copy failures repeat the same localized recovery message with shared InlineCallout. Only two simple callsites are demonstrated, so a new composite is not justified.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain shared CopyButton failure callbacks and InlineCallout; do not add another clipboard engine or speculative recovery component.

sourceStrategy: Workspace stacks by default and uses three viewport columns at xl with editor spanning two.
Actions wrap labels and flex-wrap; panels use responsive padding.
Catalog uses auto-fit minmax(min(100%,20rem),1fr); every table and all column details stay available.
CodeBlock wraps display text while preserving exact clipboard bytes; Table owns horizontal overflow containment.

issues.rule: MDC-040 / MDC-043: keyboard-accessible narrow table detail
issues.detail: Horizontal scrolling uses a plain wrapper div without an explicit focusable labeled scroll-region contract. Schema tables have no intrinsic interactive children. Cross-browser keyboard access when the table overflows remains a source-backed risk, not a demonstrated failure.
issues.fix: Shared table owner should validate overflow at narrow widths and provide opt-in focusable/labeled scroll-region props if native behavior is insufficient; preserve all three columns rather than hiding metadata.

responsive.requiredChecks: All contract widths 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560; narrow allocated shell width at xl; long identifiers/descriptions; RTL; 200% text; keyboard horizontal scrolling. None exercised.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard, screen reader, focus, contrast, touch-target and forced-colors behavior unverified
sourceStrengths: Manual and AI textareas have localized aria-label values; shared Textarea creates stable IDs and supports visible labels/descriptions.
Sections have localized aria-label values; schema tables have table names, col headers and row headers.
Decorative page/reference icons are aria-hidden; primary key is conveyed with labeled icon and literal description, not color alone.
Run and clipboard guidance use shared InlineCallout role=status; AI errors use role=alert.
Shared Button provides focus tokens; wrapping labels preserve long translated actions.

issues.detail: With a custom label, visibleLabel always uses that label instead of Copied. This page passes Copy query at SqlPlaygroundPage.tsx:236; withToast remains false. Success changes only the icon, so aria-live has no changed text and the successful main-query copy lacks a textual completion cue.
issues.fix: Shared CopyButton should expose/accept a localized copiedLabel or announce successful copying in a separate status region while retaining caller action labels, exact text and failure callbacks. Validate with both this custom-label button and the example default-label button.

issues.rule: MDC-040: 44px mobile default with documented exceptions
issues.detail: md controls have a 40px minimum and sm controls 36px. Manual actions use md; example copy and AI actions use sm. No local 44px override or target-spacing acceptance was exercised.
issues.fix: Use the existing lg/auto or an accepted shared touch-size contract where appropriate; measure actual spacing before claiming an exception or changing global density defaults.

states.initialLoading: Static reference/manual editor need no synthetic network skeleton. Optional AI is hidden while fail-closed enablement is unresolved.
states.empty: Blank/trim-empty editor disables Run/Clear/Copy. Individual empty-column cards show explicit text. Bundled catalog is nonempty; zero-table fallback is not currently implemented, but no live empty catalog is claimed.
states.error: Storage failures are silently ignored. Main/example copy failures show manual selection recovery. AI error panel surfaces a terminal error and the action can restart; manual neighbors remain visible.
states.offline: Bundled schema and current manual text remain usable without a SQL API; new AI requests depend on network. Offline is not separately identified by the inspected AI renderer.
states.stale: Editing manual SQL clears previous run/copy guidance; prompt editing clears already-captured typed draft, but late results are not invalidated. AI output remains until next start because scopeKey is omitted.
states.partial: AiOutputPanel selects the error branch instead of showing retained streamed text on terminal failure. Manual editor/catalog remain intact.
states.success: Typed proposals require explicit Apply; main Copy query retains its label and changes icon only; Run never creates results.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-046: keep asynchronous evidence bound to its request
issues.detail: onEvent captures any late successful draft tool result. Prompt Textarea remains editable during streaming (inputSlot:188-201); handlePromptChange:163-176 only clears the current draft. An old request can subsequently repopulate draft and enable Apply beside a newer prompt. Existing output also survives prompt edits because useAiStream has no scopeKey here.
issues.fix: Bind draft and output to the submitted prompt identity using the existing hook scopeKey/cancellation contract or an explicit request-generation check; ignore obsolete results and clear stale text/activity consistently. Keep editor application explicit and do not disable or delete the manual baseline.

issues.rule: MDC-026: refresh/partial failure must retain usable evidence
issues.detail: An error-state branch replaces accumulated stream text even when text is nonempty. A partial response disappears behind the error message although the hook retains it.
issues.fix: Shared AI renderer should show retained text plus a separately announced terminal error, with an explicit incomplete/proposal-only label and existing restart affordance. Never imply partial SQL is validated or executable.

issues.rule: MDC-046: preserve editing and recovery actions
issues.detail: Clear uses disabled={!canRun}, where canRun is sql.trim().length>0 at line 168. A whitespace-only nonempty draft is persisted but cannot be cleared using the Clear action.
issues.fix: Separate clear enablement from run/copy enablement: allow clearing any nonempty raw editor string while retaining trimmed run eligibility and exact draft persistence.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / mission 5-7: color should communicate meaning
visualIssues.detail: Decorative editor/catalog icons use fixed cyan-300 (also line 273); QueryReferencePanel.tsx:62,75 uses cyan icon and bullets. There are no explicit neon/glow classes in these page/domain sources, but repeated fixed decorative accent is unnecessary and is not theme-adaptive.
visualIssues.fix: Use typography.color.secondary/muted or text-[var(--text-secondary)] for decorative icons and bg-[var(--text-muted)] for neutral bullets; retain accent for meaningful primary action/state only.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / MDC-015: restrained semantic hierarchy
visualIssues.detail: All five schema cards repeat a cyan tinted/ringed icon badge; all column names use emerald-300 at line 93 despite not being success states. Primary-key amber at line 89 is meaningful but fixed. The no-columns state at line 111 uses a white overlay rather than a neutral surface token.
visualIssues.fix: Neutralize icon badges with --surface-2/--border-subtle and secondary text; render SQL identifiers with Text color=primary/mono rather than emerald. Preserve primary-key label/shape with a reviewed semantic token. Replace bg-white/[0.02] with the existing neutral surface token.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-020: shared controls own restrained chrome
visualIssues.detail: The Ask Helix button overrides outline chrome with fixed cyan border/background/light text and cyan focus ring, alongside the cyan badge at line 214. This competes with shared neutral control/focus tokens. Persisted user theme/chart accents must not be reset.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner should retain Button outline and existing --control-*/--focus-ring tokens, with a small semantic brand mark rather than saturated custom chrome; keep localized name, thinking state, wrapping and feature gating.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-012 / MDC-013 / MDC-015: theme-aware surfaces and typography
visualIssues.detail: Output uses bg-white/[0.02] and raw text-sm paragraphs; error uses fixed red-300 at lines 85-88. No rendered contrast or glow measurement was performed.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing --surface-2 plus Text/ErrorText role components and accepted semantic severity tokens. Do not alter provider output, tool evidence, usage or whitespace preservation.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-032: scope controls must truthfully describe consumed data
architectureIssues.detail: /power/sql is absent from range-enabled and vehicle-disabled lists/prefixes, so the inspected resolver gives {range:false,vehicle:true}. This page consumes no selected vehicle; its draft request contains only prompt and its catalog is install-wide. The shell vehicle control may imply scope that neither reference nor draft body consumes.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should make this install-wide route vehicle-disabled using the existing scope registry and verify the actual header/mobile drawer. Do not silently inject vehicle filters into user SQL or add a local vehicle/date selector.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-044: localize explanatory UI without recasing source data
architectureIssues.detail: Table and column descriptions are bundled English strings and rendered directly at SchemaCatalogCard.tsx:53,99. UI headings/actions are translated, but substantial human-readable schema explanations are not.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve canonical names/types/raw metadata; provide localized display descriptions through existing catalog ownership and retain authoritative SI/PII meaning. Report catalog work to its owner rather than editing shared translation resources in a page item.

competingImplementations: No second page layout, table pipeline, clipboard engine, motion owner or SQL executor was found in the inspected page dependency slice.
Schema metadata is duplicated across bundled TypeScript and the backend allowlist by design; parity is an integration concern, not permission to widen the SQL surface.
AIFeatureCard's local cyan action overrides compete with Button's existing token-owned outline chrome; reuse the existing primitive rather than add another AI button.
